git-trim automatically trims local tracking branches whose upstream branches are merged or removed.

Installation

- Download a prebuilt binary from the Releases page and place it in a directory on your PATH.

- Run `git trim` in a repository to detect and optionally delete local branches that are merged or whose upstreams are gone.
- Use `git trim --dry-run` to see what would be deleted without making changes.

import pty, os, subprocess, time, select, sys
def run_pty(cmd,cwd,inputs):
    # use script command? python pty spawn
    import pty, os
    pid, fd = pty.fork()
    if pid==0:
        os.chdir(cwd)
        os.execv(cmd[0],cmd)
    out=b""
    time.sleep(0.5)
    # read available
    def read_avail():
        nonlocal out
        while True:
            r,_,_=select.select([fd],[],[],0.5)
            if not r: break
            try:
                data=os.read(fd, 4096)
            except OSError:
                break
            if not data: break
            out+=data
            print("CHUNK",data)
    read_avail()
    for inp in inputs:
        print("SEND",inp)
        os.write(fd, inp)

    try:
        _,status=os.waitpid(pid,0)
        print("status",os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status))
    except Exception as e:
        print(e)
    print("FULL",out)

os.close(slave)
time.sleep(0.5)
# read stdout available (nonblock)
import fcntl
flags=fcntl.fcntl(p.stdout, fcntl.F_GETFL); fcntl.fcntl(p.stdout, fcntl.F_SETFL, flags|os.O_NONBLOCK)
try: print("STDOUT avail:", p.stdout.read())
except Exception as e: print(e)
# read pty
r,_,_=select.select([master],[],[],0.5)
if r: print("PTY:", os.read(master,4096))
os.write(master,b"n")
time.sleep(0.5)
r,_,_=select.select([master],[],[],0.5)
if r: print("PTY2:", os.read(master,4096))
try: print("STDOUT after:", p.stdout.read())
except Exception as e: print(e)

import subprocess, difflib
ORIG="/workspace/executable"; NEW="/workspace/target/debug/git-trim"
def run_case(label, setup_cmds, args, cwd):
    results=[]
    for exe in [ORIG,NEW]:
        subprocess.run("rm -rf /tmp/cust && cp -a /tmp/repro2 /tmp/cust 2>/dev/null || true",shell=True)
        # setup_cmds is a script string executed fresh for each
        subprocess.run(setup_cmds,shell=True,capture_output=True)
        r=subprocess.run(["executable"]+args,executable=exe,cwd=cwd,capture_output=True,text=True)
        # state
        state=subprocess.run("git branch -a; git status --porcelain; git symbolic-ref HEAD || echo detached; git ls-remote origin 2>/dev/null",shell=True,cwd=cwd,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
        results.append((r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr,state))
    o,n=results
    # canonical delete order and hashes in state? state hashes will same if setup deterministic within second; compare rough
    same = o[:3]==n[:3]
    print(label,"OK" if same else "DIFF")

                            required_text: Some(format!("diverged:{}", remote.remote)),

                    } else {

                    required_text: Some(format!("remote:{}", remote.remote)),

    17	}
    18	
    19	pub fn remote_parts(refname: &str) -> Option<(String, String)> {
    20	    let display = refname.strip_prefix("refs/remotes/")?;
    21	    let (remote, branch) = display.split_once('/')?;
    22	    Some((remote.to_owned(), branch.to_owned()))
    23	}
    24	
    25	pub fn local_head_ref_from_remote_head_target(refname: &str) -> String {
    26	    let branch = {
    27	        assert!(refname.starts_with("refs/remotes/"));
    28	        let rest = refname.strip_prefix("refs/remotes/").unwrap();
    29	        let (_remote, branch) = rest.split_once('/').unwrap_or(("", rest));
    30	        branch.to_owned()
    31	    };
    32	    format!("refs/heads/{branch}")
    33	}
    34	
    35	fn branch_from_head_contents(contents: &str) -> Option<String> {
    36	    let contents = contents.trim();
    37	    let refname = contents.strip_prefix("ref: ")?;
    38	    refname.strip_prefix("refs/heads/").map(ToOwned::to_owned)
    39	}
    40	
    41	pub fn worktree_branch_map(
    42	    repo: &Repository,
    43	) -> anyhow::Result<HashMap<String, PathBuf>> {
    44	    let mut result = HashMap::new();
    45	    let current_workdir = repo.workdir().map(ToOwned::to_owned);
    46	    let commondir = repo.commondir().to_owned();
    47	
    48	    let mut candidates: Vec<(PathBuf, String)> = Vec::new();
    49	
    50	    if let Ok(main_repo) = Repository::open(&commondir) {
    51	        if let Some(main_workdir) = main_repo.workdir() {
    52	            if let Ok(head) = std::fs::read_to_string(commondir.join("HEAD")) {
    53	                candidates.push((main_workdir.to_owned(), head));
    54	            }
    55	        }
    56	    }
    57	
    58	    let worktrees_dir = commondir.join("worktrees");
    59	    if let Ok(read_dir) = std::fs::read_dir(&worktrees_dir) {
    60	        let mut dirs: Vec<PathBuf> = read_dir.filter_map(|entry| entry.ok().map(|e| e.path())).collect();
    61	        dirs.sort();
    62	        for dir in dirs {
    63	            let Ok(gitdir) = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join("gitdir")) else {
    64	                continue;
    65	            };
    66	            let gitdir = gitdir.trim();
    67	            let Some(workdir) = gitdir.strip_suffix("/.git") else {
    68	                continue;
    69	            };
    70	            let Ok(head) = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join("HEAD")) else {
    71	                continue;
    72	            };
    73	            candidates.push((PathBuf::from(workdir), head));
    74	        }
    75	    }
    76	
    77	    // Also consult libgit2's worktree registry. This makes the current
    78	    // worktree known even when its administrative directory has an unusual
    79	    // layout; checked-out paths are still read from the metadata above in
    80	    // preference to opening the worktree itself.
    81	    if let Ok(worktrees) = repo.worktrees() {
    82	        for name_opt in worktrees.iter() {
    83	            let Ok(Some(name)) = name_opt else { continue };
    84	            if let Ok(worktree) = repo.find_worktree(name) {
    85	                let head_path = commondir
    86	                    .join("worktrees")
    87	                    .join(name)
    88	                    .join("HEAD");
    89	                if let Ok(head) = std::fs::read_to_string(head_path) {
    90	                    candidates.push((worktree.path().to_owned(), head));
    91	                }
    92	            }
    93	        }
    94	    }
    95	
    96	    for (path, head) in candidates {
    97	        if let Some(current) = &current_workdir {
    98	            if path == *current {
    99	                continue;
   100	            }
   101	        }
   102	        if let Some(branch) = branch_from_head_contents(&head) {
   103	            result.entry(branch).or_insert(path);
   104	        }
   105	    }
   106	    Ok(result)
   107	}
